result.description: Time tracking, invoicing and expense/project reporting SaaS.
result.auth_detail: Personal Access Token (Bearer + Harvest-Account-Id header) created in Harvest ID developers page; OAuth2 auth-code flow for apps used by others (apps registered in Harvest ID). Basic auth dropped in v2.
result.access_detail: Docs state no plan restriction. PATs and OAuth2 apps are created self-serve in Harvest ID developers. Any Harvest account (free tier or trial) should work. Exact plan terms not verified on a pricing page.
result.api_notes: REST/JSON v2: time entries, timers, projects, tasks, clients, contacts, invoices, estimates, expenses, users, company, reports. Rate limit 100 req/15s (reports 100/15min). User-Agent header required.

evidence.quote: The V2 API requires an access token to authenticate requests.
Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.
Personal Access Tokens have the `all` scope by default, so you have full access to all of your accounts.
The Harvest V2 API is a REST API that allows you to interact with your Harvest account programmatically.
The rate limit for general API requests is 100 requests per 15 seconds.
Run a time report for a date range, grouped by project, by client, or by person. Each total is split into billable and non-billable hours.
